# Native launcher screenshot comparisons

143 approved images captured November 6, 2026: 70 matched before/proposed pairs and three contextual editor-options views. Current main 0af7a9f5 uses the same Nintendo demo catalog as the proposal. Duo captures retain the Device Hub model and pose, with whitespace cropped. Readiness, versions, play history, settings, and controller values are simulated. These images do not establish game compatibility or physical-device acceptance.
